channel.title: Lokesh Ram Chand — Portfolio — Blog
channel.description: A dedicated software engineer building intelligent, scalable platforms. I combine modern full-stack development with machine learning technologies to architect comprehensive, production-ready solutions.

item.title: When Success Doesn't Mean It Worked
item.description: How a silent protobuf marshal failure in Birdwatcher, Milvus's diagnostic tool, let repair commands report success while writing corrupted data to etcd, and the fix.

item.title: The Bug That Wasn't a Bug Yet: Hunting a Dormant API Contract Violation in Meshery
item.description: How reading a naming-convention doc closely enough led to a 20-site fix for a pagination bug in a CNCF project that hadn't broken anything, yet.

item.title: Hardening a 15-Phase AI API for Pre-Production
item.description: An architectural deep dive and pre-production audit of Velar, detailing how to secure a FastAPI service against concurrency races, missing indexes, root containers, and dependency CVEs.

item.title: Why I Didn't Just Use ChatGPT for Transaction Parsing
item.description: Every fintech demo this year routes bank SMS text through a chat completion and calls it categorization. Here's the pipeline I built instead: three cheap, boring, deterministic layers before an LLM ever gets a vote.

item.title: Building a Grounded RAG Pipeline for Financial Data with Milvus and Ollama
item.description: An architectural deep dive into how Velar builds a privacy-first, grounded RAG pipeline using Milvus, Ollama, and FastAPI without relying on external LLM APIs.

item.title: Designing a Memory State Machine for ML Predictions
item.description: An architectural deep dive into how Velar tracks merchant trust explicitly using a frequency-based state machine, built with FastAPI and MongoDB.

item.title: Building an Nginx Configuration I Could Actually Maintain
item.description: A practical guide to creating and maintaining Nginx configurations that are both efficient and easy to manage.

item.title: Owning the Stack: Building My Personal Cloud
item.description: A journey into self-hosting and the lessons learned while building a personal cloud infrastructure.
